extend_markdown_with_admonition: register the AdmonitionExtension on a Markdown instance to enable rST-style admonition support
parse_admonition_content: use AdmonitionProcessor.parse_content to retrieve sibling admonition elements and handle indented block content
run_admonition_processor: run the AdmonitionProcessor on a block list to parse and render admonition div elements
extract_class_and_title: use get_class_and_title to extract the admonition class name and optional title from a regex match
create_admonition_extension: call makeExtension to instantiate and return a new AdmonitionExtension for Python-Markdown
